diagram_math_checks.justification: h_t is reachable, a has positive conditional selection probability, and o satisfies q(o|b_t,a)>0. Thus h_{t+1}=(h_t,a,o) has positive probability. Vertical arrows compute conditional distributions of S_t and S_{t+1}, respectively, in Delta(S), as defined in def-belief-state-and-bayes-filter. These are computations, not hidden-state transitions.

Top arrow extends h_t by a,o. Left arrow yields b_t=Pr(S_t in · | h_t). Bottom arrow is the partial Bayes update for fixed a,o, defined on beliefs with q>0. Right arrow yields b_{t+1}=Pr(S_{t+1} in · | h_t,A_t=a,O_{t+1}=o). Proof step 1.1 gives the joint mass; step 2.1 divides by positive q and proves the two routes coincide.
